_comment: guidance_file_tokens is the single-read ceiling for instruction files and agent prompts in every project (measured at about 3 bytes per token, the safe side); root_skill_max_bytes keeps each SKILL.md just below it in an installed mod. context_budget (maintainer decision R-1, 2026-11-06) applies in the source package, where CLAUDE_template.md exists: the instruction template holds at most template_tokens, each SKILL.md at most skill_tokens with details moved to references/, and each skill description is one sentence of at most description_max_chars characters. A token is estimated as bytes_per_token UTF-8 bytes (LF line endings); the o200k tokenizer measured 4.3 to 5.1 bytes per token on this guidance on 2026-11-06.
